statements.query: SELECT "menu_items"."id" AS "id", "menu_items"."name" AS "name", "menu_items"."price" AS "price", "menu_items"."image_url" AS "image_url", "menu_items"."description" AS "description", "menu_items"."restaurant_id" AS "restaurant_id" FROM "menu_items"
SELECT "restaurants"."id" AS "id", "restaurants"."name" AS "name", "restaurants"."phone" AS "phone", "restaurants"."address" AS "address", "restaurants"."image_url" AS "image_url" FROM "restaurants"
